title: WorkFlow Space — Community & Content
summary: Content strategy, community building, and organic + paid growth for WorkFlow Space — a premium co-working brand in Ho Chi Minh City.
description:
Developed a content-first growth strategy combining organic social, SEO blog content, and paid campaigns. Managed a team of freelance content creators, coordinated shoots, and set KPI frameworks tracked weekly.

Grew Instagram from 2,000 to 18,000 followers in 8 months through systematic posting, reel strategy, and community engagement. Ran Google Ads and Meta retargeting to drive workspace bookings.

Deliverables included a brand guide refresh, content playbook, and monthly performance dashboards for stakeholders.
